papers.title: Rebuilding Critical Thinking in the AI Era: A University Learning Framework
papers.area: AI in Education & Learning Systems Research
bullets: A framework for how universities can bring AI into teaching while protecting critical thinking and conceptual learning.
Proposes a multi-stage learning architecture: AI-assisted exploration, human-only reflection, adaptive assignments and process-based assessment.
Looks at the effects of AI overdependence and ways to keep students cognitively engaged.
papers.objective: Make sure technology improves learning without reducing how much students engage with understanding and applying ideas, so humans stay responsible for the reasoning.
